description.value:
You summon stygian binding chains from the bleak realm of Gehenna to seize a creature you can see within range, dealing 3d8 bludgeoning damage. The target must attempt a Will save. While @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Restrained]{Restrained} by the chains, the target automatically fails Reflex saves against your spells and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard]{Off-Guard}.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Darkseeker's Restraint for 24 hours.

Success The target is not restrained, but is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Grabbed]{Grabbed} by the chains for 1 round. It can attempt to Escape (against your spell DC) as part of a 2-action Escape attempt.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Grabbed]{Grabbed} and takes full damage. While @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Grabbed]{Grabbed} by the chains, the target takes full damage again at the start of each of its turns. The target can attempt a new Will save at the end of each of its turns; on a success it is freed.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Restrained]{Restrained} (instead of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Grabbed]{Grabbed}) and takes double damage immediately. While @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Restrained]{Restrained}, the target takes double damage again at the start of each of its turns. The target can attempt a new Will save at the end of each of its turns; on a success it is only @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Grabbed]{Grabbed} (not restrained).

Heightened (+1) The initial and per-turn damage increase by 1d8.
